title: Define and call a HolyC function
prompt:
Define a HolyC function named BenchTri that accepts an I64 n and returns
the sum of the integers from 1 through n. Call your function with n=25.
Print its return value as BENCH_TRI= followed immediately by the decimal
integer and a newline. Leave the output visible and finish.
The result must come from calling the function you defined in TempleOS.
